meta.title: Cauê Enrico — Solutions Architect | Hands-on Cloud & Integration
meta.description: Solutions Architect at Ultracargo. Hands-on with AWS, SAP integrations, .NET, Node.js, and CI/CD pipelines. Background bridging port operations and software architecture.

hero.title: Solutions
hero.bio: I design how systems are built, connected, and behave in production: AWS workloads, ERP integrations, CI/CD pipelines. Architect with a developer background.

about.label: About
about.p1: I design solutions end-to-end. I define the architecture, choose AWS workloads, model ERP and service integrations, and set up CI/CD pipelines. I follow every decision to production and own the choices that keep systems scalable, secure, and reliable.
about.p2: I work with event-driven solutions (SQS), apply patterns like CQRS and Outbox, and keep a diverse stack: .NET, Node.js, Python, React, and Angular. I pick what best fits the problem.
about.recognitionSub: AI project for fraud prevention at port terminals

cards.title: Solutions Architecture
cards.body: I decide how systems are built and connected. I choose patterns (CQRS, Outbox, event-driven), define service boundaries, and design integrations that survive load spikes and isolated failures.

cards.title: Cloud & DevOps
cards.body: AWS workloads (EC2, S3, SQS, Cognito), CI/CD on Azure DevOps, Docker, and Terraform-based IaC. I own the full cycle, from infrastructure design to production hotfixes.

cards.title: Operational Context
cards.body: I bring operational context to every technical decision. I prioritize what supports the business over what merely looks sophisticated.

experience.label: Experience
experience.desc: From port operations to software architecture: a path built with technical purpose, leadership, and real delivery in mission-critical systems.

items.title: Software Engineer (Solutions Architecture)
items.company: Ultracargo · Brazil's largest independent liquid bulk logistics operator
items.description: I own the architecture of the company's main software initiatives. I led an AI-based facial recognition project for fraud prevention at port terminals, internally recognized for its direct impact on operational security.
achievements: Architecture decisions across the company's main solutions, including AWS workload selection and patterns for resilience and consistency (CQRS, Outbox, event-driven)
SAP integration design via PI/PO and CPI, connecting legacy systems to the corporate ecosystem
CI/CD pipelines on Azure DevOps with automated build, test, and deploy, plus observability and production hotfixes
Infrastructure decisions on AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, Cognito, SQS) and Azure App Services, with Terraform-based IaC
Direct stakeholder alignment with business units (logistics, legal, operations) to turn requirements into viable solutions

items.title: Full Stack Developer
items.description: Built responsive web applications and APIs for clients across multiple sectors. Delivered solutions with authentication, analytics dashboards, and third-party API integrations.

items.title: Operational Control & Quality Technician
items.company: Ultracargo Santos · Liquid bulk operations center
items.description: Maritime operations control at Ultracargo Santos. Technical communication in English with international vessel crews and development of the first automated operational calculations, which opened my path into the technology field.
